# KataGo Remote One-Click v0.1.0

The first stable release turns a Linux x86_64 NVIDIA GPU server into a private KataGo Analysis WebSocket endpoint with one command.

## Included

- Authenticated WSS bridge compatible with LizzieYzy Next and KaTrain-style Analysis clients.
- One-command installation of pinned KataGo 1.18.2, official Transformer 10B model, and cloudflared.
- Private 256-bit URL token, localhost-only listener, single-client isolation, and safe query limits.
- Terminal and PNG QR codes.
- Start, stop, status, diagnostics, logs, restart, and link-revocation commands.
- Guided Google Colab notebook.

## Quick start

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wimi321/katago-remote-one-click/v0.1.0/install.sh | bash
```

Use a Linux x86_64 NVIDIA server image with CUDA 12 and preferably cuDNN 9. See the [Chinese guide](https://github.com/wimi321/katago-remote-one-click/blob/v0.1.0/README.zh-CN.md) or [English guide](https://github.com/wimi321/katago-remote-one-click/blob/v0.1.0/README.md).

The generated WSS link is a private credential. Do not publish it.
